subject: Update: new commit / best-case / pipeline definitions + office hours
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Sales Leadership <sales-leads@redwood.com>, Revenue Ops <revops@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Update: new commit / best-case / pipeline definitions + office hours

Team —

Quick note with an operational change we need to adopt this quarter: RevOps and Finance completed a short reconciliation of our forecast buckets and we've standardized definitions for Commit, Best Case, and Pipeline. The goal is practical calibration so our weekly commit reviews are faster and fewer downstream surprises. Please read the short summary below and join one of two office hours next week if you want to walk through examples from your book.

Summary (TL;DR):
- Commit: Legally executed purchase order/contract, or a documented signed approval from procurement/legal AND an explicit timeline for invoicing (PO number or contract signature date). No assumptions on follow-up approvals.
- Best Case: Strong verbal commitment + positive procurement signals (PO in progress, pricing approved), buyer has assigned an internal owner and a clear go-live quarter; still not fully executed. Treat as >70% confidence for internal forecasting but do NOT move to Commit bucket.
- Pipeline (Upside/Unqualified): All other active opportunities (including early-stage demos, discovery, and opportunities without procurement alignment). Use conservative conversion assumptions.

Operational changes:
- Weekly commit review (Thursdays, 10am PT) will only surface deals in Commit and Best Case. Pipeline items are reviewed monthly unless flagged by AE or CS for risk.
- Any move to Commit requires: a) PO/contract PDF or b) email from procurement/legal approving the purchase with PO number OR c) finance-approved SOW with signatures. Evidence goes in the opportunity notes and uploaded to the CRM link.
- If you're unsure, tag the deal with the new label "forecast:clarify" and RevOps will queue it for calibration.

Attachments: full cheat sheet (commit-guidelines-v2.pdf) and a one-page quick reference. I've left one-sheet examples using fictional deals for calibration exercises.

Office hours (pick one):
- Tue 2026-09-14 09:00-10:00 PT (practical examples, bring 2 deals each)
- Wed 2026-09-15 16:00-17:00 PT (EM/manager track — how to coach reps)

Ask: update any active opportunities in your pipeline by EOD Monday 2026-09-13 with the new label and attach supporting evidence if you believe the deal is Commit or Best Case.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

If ACME-ENT should be Best Case I will upload the email thread and tag it. Otherwise I'll leave it as Pipeline and bring it up during the monthly review.

- Can we get a short checklist in the one-sheet that reps can paste into CRM notes to make sure reviewers have what they need (PO PDF, procurement email, legal sign-off email, pricing approval screenshot)?

Proposal: I recommend a 30-minute calibration slot on Wed 2026-09-15 at 10:00 PT for West Coast AEs to run 6 quick examples — faster than a full office hours. If RevOps/Finance can join for 20 minutes we can align quickly.

I'll also attach the ACME deal summary (acme-deal-summary.xlsx) for reference — Jonas, if you want me to drop the procurement emails into CRM I can do that after you confirm.

Ben

Jonas —

Great questions. Short answers to keep the book clear before office hours: 

- ACME-ENT as described = Best Case. Verbal + pricing approved + procurement "PO in progress" with identified approver = Best Case. Mark as Best Case, upload the procurement email, and tag forecast:clarify if you are unsure. We will not recategorize until a PO/contract PDF or signed SOW is uploaded.
- Competitive/scoping deals: leave in Pipeline until scoping complete and procurement alignment exists. Confidence from the AE alone is not enough for Best Case.

Ben — agree on the checklist. RevOps will add a 4-item checklist to the one-sheet and I'll confirm the quick 30-minute West Coast calibration on Wed 2026-09-15 10:00 PT. RevOps can schedule the calendar invite and I'll ask Finance to join the first 15 minutes to confirm the Commit evidence threshold.

Thanks all — update your deals by EOD today and add the tag so RevOps can pre-load the calibration queue. I appreciate the quick turnaround.

Soojin
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
